class.name: terrainCostAdapter/RoughnessFilter
class.description: Local surface roughness (population stddev of a layer over a square window), computed with NaN-masked integral images: O(1) per cell, independent of window size.

class.name: terrainCostAdapter/PlaneFitFilter
class.description: Least-squares plane fit over a square window, yielding slope, a SIGNED step (residual from the plane, so ramps read ~0 at any angle while walls and ditches both stand out) and a slope-corrected roughness (RMS residual about the plane). NaN-masked integral images: O(1) per cell, independent of window size. Supersedes RoughnessFilter and the NormalVectorsFilter + MathExpressionFilter slope pair.
